message.content: What are the indices of the two numbers in the array [2, 7, 11, 15] that add up to the target sum of 9?

function.name: TwoSum_twoSum
function.description: Finds two numbers in the given array that add up to the target sum and returns their indices. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

nums.description: An array of integers to search for the two numbers. This is Java Array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type integer; they are not in string representation.

target.description: The target sum to find within the array. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.
